arguments.prompt:
Draw BRAND-NEW detailed native PIXEL-ART game animation bodies of ADULT ELLEN RIPLEY in ALIENS (1986), before the power-loader fight. Match the supplied new identity drawing ONLY for her human likeness and exact costume: short curly dark-brown hair, blue-gray civilian utility/work jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, dark practical webbing and belt, light worn sneakers. Adult human proportions. The only weapon is the olive/dark-green M41A PULSE RIFLE with its recognizable compact conventional receiver, long shoulder stock, short black barrel and underslung grenade-launcher housing. No power loader, spacesuit, underwear outfit, bald head, later-film clone, armor or helmet. Keep two natural arms, two natural legs, bare visible human hands. On locomotion and ledge rows the M41A is securely on its physical sling along her back/hip and both hands are FREE when gripping or climbing. Never make the rifle float or appear as a wand. On the explicit gunshot rows shoulder it with TWO HANDS, one at trigger grip and one under fore-end. The movements are original adaptations for this crossover platform-fighting game, not claims of official film animation. Guard is a physical protective brace, charge is only physical preparation, aerial moves are ordinary human jumping motions: no magic, aura, shield bubble, telekinesis, flying, beam, opponent, creature, wound, blood or gore. Only a tiny conventional flash AT THE ACTUAL RIFLE BARREL is allowed in the single row that explicitly calls for a shot; recovery frames have no flash. Do NOT copy any pose from the reference sheet.

LAYOUT: draw EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS × FOUR ROWS = SIXTEEN COMPLETE separate native pixel-art bodies on a tall portrait canvas. Only4rows, NOT8rows. Use truly transparent RGBA, no scene, ground, platform, shadow, text or frame. Keep the character about200px crown-to-sole if canvas1024×1536; every cell has huge transparent gutters on all sides. Every curl, bare fingertip, sneaker and slung M41A must remain COMPLETE inside the cell, no canvas edge touching. One anatomical body scale throughout all16; crouches and hangs must stay proportionally smaller than upright. No missing row, duplicate body or truncated leg. For climbed/crouched poses draw BOTH lower legs and BOTH sneakers: no invisible platform may crop any anatomy. Four different chronological poses across every row, facing RIGHT.

ROW1 jumpStart: four physically chronological START-OF-JUMP bodies: frame1 fully standing preparation, frame2 feet planted with knees deeply bent, frame3 heels lift and knees extend, frame4 actual takeoff with both sneakers visible. Do not make all4 airborne.
ROW2 crouchCharge: four distinct LOW crouched physical preparation/breathing bodies, hands and shoulders gather; rifle SLUNG on back, no magic charge, remain genuinely crouched in all4.
ROW3 perfectShield: precise human physical forearm parry, stance dip, one forearm blocks RIGHT, balanced recovery; four different bodies, no bubble shield or glowing VFX.
ROW4 uprightCalibration: four distinct completely UPRIGHT relaxed anatomical calibration bodies, hands lowered and rifle slung back; same body scale as all other rows. These four are reserved, not game states.

FINAL CHECK: EXACTLY16 full-body figures,4 columns ×4 rows, no incomplete row or cropped body. Completely transparent empty gutters on EVERY side. All4poses in a row genuinely articulated and different.
